title: Users
subtitle: Local accounts and their roles

webOIDC.title: Web OIDC client
webOIDC.description: Optional public client for browser-based cluster sign-in (authorization code with PKCE). It is used only for clusters whose kubeconfig names this identity provider (issuer) and signs in with the authorization code; other clusters and other sign-in methods keep the client from their kubeconfig. Set KUBRON_PUBLIC_URL and register its /auth/cluster/callback URL at the identity provider. Do not enter a client secret.
webOIDC.issuerRequired: Enter the issuer URL: without it the client is not used.

idle.title: Auto sign-out on inactivity
idle.description: The session ends if the user does not move the mouse or press keys. Running terminals and port forwards are closed. Applies to all accounts.
